goal.request: Make source-faithful abstract descriptions such as skin-value families, attractiveness, and atmosphere available from any source image without per-user memory: retain the abstract direction together with detailed controls instead of suppressing it or replacing it with decomposition alone.

evidence.claim: The user requires direct, source-faithful language for visibly different skin presentations, attractiveness, and atmosphere, and explicitly judges abstract direction plus detailed description to be more faithful than detail-only substitution.
evidence.artifact: Conversation feedback and implementation authorization on 2026-08-25

evidence.claim: The motivating source is a portrait whose user-identified invariants include very light milky-looking skin, a model or idol-like attractive facial gestalt, strong light-dark separation, and a mysterious or fantastical overall reading.

perceptual_contract.primary_success_condition: When an abstract property is a high-confidence P0/P1 current-source invariant and removing it would materially change the image reading, the prompt states that aggregate property once and immediately follows it with source-specific literal controls; otherwise the aggregate stays diagnostic or omitted.
perceptual_contract.user_appeal: Preserve the large semantic direction carried by plain descriptions of skin presentation, attractiveness, and mysterious or fantastical atmosphere, while retaining the detailed evidence that makes those terms source-specific.

invariants.statement: Aggregate source meaning and causal details are non-substitutable when both are material: one aggregate anchor leads one owned decomposition.

A source-visible attractiveness reading may be retained as a non-identifying generation prior but never replaces face/body geometry or authorizes retouching, idealization, relighting, recropping, or demographic inference.
Surface and lighting labels may originate from the current source after independent axis observation and compatibility review, not only from external vocabulary.
Exact model/version calibration evaluates response effectiveness and leakage; it is not the sole permission to state high-confidence visible evidence.
Runtime instructions contain no motivating label list, preferred skin value, beauty preset, mood preset, lighting combination, person category, or generator workaround.
causal_controls: motivating literals confined to evaluation and tests

flexible_dimensions: which aggregate descriptor, if any, the current source supports
whether the material invariant concerns a human, non-human surface, lighting, capture, genre, or atmosphere
the literal detailed controls required by that source
wording when evidence is ambiguous or the omission counterfactual is preserved

mismatches.source_state: A visible aggregate property may carry the image's primary reading even before generator-response calibration exists.
mismatches.render_state: The prior contract allowed current-source aggregate appearance, lighting, and aesthetic labels to influence production only after exact model calibration, so detail-only wording could lose their global direction.

mismatches.source_state: The overall attractiveness reading can be P0/P1 independently of any one local feature.
mismatches.render_state: The prior runtime rules forced attractiveness to supporting-only status even when the omission counterfactual was material drift.

mismatches.source_state: The current image itself can support a plain aggregate surface or lighting descriptor after axis review.
mismatches.render_state: The language tools accepted only user-supplied or versioned-vocabulary candidates, excluding the analyst's provenance-bound current-source observation.

hypotheses.statement: Keeping one material aggregate descriptor immediately before its literal decomposition preserves global semantic direction without letting the label replace causal evidence.
hypotheses.falsifier: Unrelated prompt evaluations show that qualified aggregate-plus-detail blocks are less source-faithful than detail-only controls, or that the aggregate repeatedly overrides its decomposition.

hypotheses.statement: Explicit provenance, confidence, P0/P1 priority, and omission counterfactual distinguish material current-source language from preferred or speculative labels without a fixed vocabulary.
hypotheses.falsifier: Held-out cases admit low-confidence, non-material, preserved-counterfactual, or incompatible labels, or reject an otherwise qualified direction solely because it lacks a preset vocabulary entry.

hypotheses.statement: Separating source-description qualification from generator-response calibration prevents observation loss while keeping render-effectiveness claims model/version scoped.
hypotheses.falsifier: The uncalibrated qualified path is reported as proven render fidelity, or model-specific response evidence leaks into universal source semantics.

intervention.general_rule: Use retain-and-decompose: a provenance-bound current-source abstract descriptor may emit once when confidence is high or medium, viewer priority is P0/P1, omission causes material drift, compatibility passes where applicable, and already-owned literal controls immediately follow. Human attractiveness uses the existing non-identifying generation-prior path. Model calibration remains a separate effectiveness path.
intervention.generalization_basis: The gate is driven by current-source evidence, importance, counterfactual loss, ownership, and adjacency. It chooses no skin value, beauty level, demographic, mood, lighting style, subject, or generator response in advance.

decision.rationale: The source rules, validators, compiled profiles, and generic held-out prompt fixtures now implement retain-and-decompose across human attractiveness, surface language, lighting language, and aesthetic or atmosphere summaries without installing the motivating labels as runtime defaults. The motivating portrait has not been rerun through a fresh independent reverse-prompt execution or generator after this change, so render fidelity and post-change user judgment remain unscored and the change is not promoted beyond prompt behavior.
